newsitem.title: USA: CME to switch Eurodollar settlement to BBA rate.
newsitem.headline: CME to switch Eurodollar settlement to BBA rate.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange said Monday it will start using British Bankers' Association fixing rates for the final settlement prices in CME Eurodollar and LIBOR futures contracts, beginning January 13, 1997.
It said the Commodity Futures Trading Commission approved the change on Friday.

CME currently computes its own reference rates for futures settlement. When CME's rates diverged from BBA's on settlement day, hedgers were exposed to basis risk. BBA rates usually are set at 0500 CST/1100 GMT, so the CME said Eurodollar and LIBOR futures on settlement day will trade on GLOBEX until 0500 CST.
